The '''2019–20 season''' was '''[[Juventus FC|Juventus Football Club]]''''s 122nd in existence and 13th consecutive season in the top-flight of [[Football in Italy|Italian football]]. In addition to the domestic league, Juventus competed in the [[2019–20 Coppa Italia|Coppa Italia]], losing to Napoli in the final,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.skysports.com/football/napoli-vs-juventus/report/425074|title=Napoli 0-0 Juventus (4-2 pens): Alex Meret the shootout hero in Coppa Italia final|website=Sky Sports|date=18 June 2020|access-date=20 July 2020}}</ref> [[2019 Supercoppa Italiana|Supercoppa Italiana]], and the [[2019–20 UEFA Champions League|Champions League]].
